shipLog.text: ◆ Docking at station! Your docking fee includes FREE access to the docking fee! Additional services are also fees! CHIP loves an itemized life!
◆ Planting registered! Your crop's warranty begins NOW and covers nothing! Nature has never accepted liability!
NOW ARRIVING: Kepler-78b (Provisional)! Trip cost: −4 FOOD, −3 H2O, −2 FUEL, −1 O2, +1 MORALE, 9 DAYS. RATE your…
◆ Soil sampler survey logged (1/3). The colony office will want this.
CAPTAIN’S CHOICE at The Paperwork: “Sign everything without reading”! BOLD leadership!
◆ CHIP's listener metrics are at nominal cruise levels. He considers the silence an opportunity to run more ads. He is running more ads.
NOW ARRIVING: Asteroid Field 2! Trip cost: −4 FOOD, −3 H2O, −2 FUEL, −1 O2, +1 MORALE, 10 DAYS. RATE your journey!
CAPTAIN’S CHOICE at Unidentified Vessel: “RESPOND WITH ONE PULSE”! BOLD leadership!
Your single pulse reaches them. RESULTS: +8 MORALE, 2 DAYS! ★★★★★
NOW ARRIVING: Marginal Eden! Trip cost: −4 FOOD, −3 H2O, −2 FUEL, −1 O2, +1 MORALE, 9 DAYS. RATE your journey!
◆ Soil sampler survey logged (2/3). The colony office will want this.
◆ MARV appends the reference: solar flares are a genuine, studied hazard of leaving home.
CAPTAIN’S CHOICE at Weather Report: “Take the shield console yourself”! BOLD leadership!
The brace fried halfway through and the last surges landed… RESULTS: −12 HULL, −3 MORALE, 2 DAYS. ★★☆☆☆ Rate us anyway!
◆ Thanks for accepting our Terms without reading them! Most people do, and our Legal team adores every one of them!
GROWBAY UPDATE: Soybean hit VEGETATIVE! 29% grown, health 97. INVEST!

identity.name: Ines Vahl
identity.story: They map places for a survey office that stopped paying them two years ago. They kept mapping. They stowed away because your route crosses three sectors whose charts they know to be wrong, and being aboard a ship headed into a known error was, professionally speaking, irresistible.
identity.line: Your nav charts are wrong at marker sixty-one. Charmingly wrong. Fatally wrong. May I see the helm?
identity.join_note: Draws corrections directly onto official charts in pen. The pen is the statement.
